title: ARC active plan pointer
description: plans/current.json - the manifest naming the active snapshot. Written ONLY by /arc-publish-plan, via write-temp plus rename. The same field set, scoped to one snapshot, is reused verbatim as plans/<plan-id>/manifest.json. An ARC publication (P-E) writes its ARC literal as arcId into both, so plans/arcs/<ARC-ID>/current.json and the snapshot's manifest.json carry the same arcId as plan.json (three-way equality, K9); legacy pointers and manifests without arcId remain valid and byte-unchanged.

planId.description: Directory name under plans/ holding the active snapshot. "arcs" is reserved for the plans/arcs/ pointer container (B4).

planHash.description: SHA-256 of plan.json bytes exactly as written. Every worker re-verifies this before acting (W-V3).

ref.description: Commit SHA the snapshot was published against.

publishedBy.description: Owner identity recorded at publish time. Advisory provenance, not an authorization token.

supersedesPlanId.description: The planId this snapshot replaced, or null for the first publication.

staleSourceAcknowledged.description: true when the owner overrode P-V14 because CHECKPOINT.md was newer than the source artifact.

refMismatchAcknowledged.description: true when the owner overrode P-V10.

carriedOverClaims.description: Claims that were live against supersedesPlanId at publication. Recorded for audit ONLY. Publication never rewrites a live claim - silently retargeting one would be stale-claim stealing under another name.

arcId.description: OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). Present, and equal to <ARC-ID>, in plans/arcs/<ARC-ID>/current.json and in the manifest.json of an ARC snapshot; absent in plans/current.json and in every legacy manifest.

OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). ARC identity. Absent in every legacy record; present in every ARC-scoped record and equal to the ARC it belongs to - the publisher's ARC literal for a snapshot, its manifest and plans/arcs/<ARC-ID>/current.json (three-way equality), the arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/ directory for claims, tokens and the holders taken for that ARC. Never inferred from a task-id prefix, a filename or a slug. The reserved Windows device-name guard applies uniformly (N-3). The schema validates shape only; namespace rules live in scripts/lib/runtime-identity.js.
